findings.evidence: git worktree add against 2a8272d (M10.34, the last commit before M10.35 fixed lib.sh's milestone_subject_re) and running `bash scripts/check-milestone-review.sh --milestone M10` there prints '34 of 34 commit(s) in M10 have not been read as a whole' -- not 35. Independently confirmed by simulating milestone_commits' own regex (as it read at that commit) against `git log --reverse --format='%H %s' 2a8272d`: 34 matches, all non-lettered M10.* subjects (M10.18a/M10.18b correctly excluded, since M10.35's fix had not landed). The same reconstruction exactly reproduces the other four rounds' stated counts (33, 38, 40, 41), so this is an isolated off-by-one in round 2's narrative, not a methodology mismatch. Round 1-3's own verdict artifacts were 'superseded and not kept' per eab0c02's own text, so this is checkable only by replaying history, not by reading a stored file; it does not affect the two kept (round 4 and round 5) artifacts, both of which recompute exactly against the actual commit list and hash correctly, nor any gate, nor the substance of any finding (M10.34-M10.39 all trace to real commits that fixed what they claim).
findings.summary: eab0c02's own commit message (and the mirrored M10.16 backlog row) claims round 2 of the closing review covered 35 commits, but running check-milestone-review.sh at that exact point in history (commit 2a8272d, M10.34, before M10.35's regex fix landed) reports 34.
